issue_context.title: DataProtectionProvider.Create(string applicationName, X509Certificate2 certificate) never works
issue_context.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### Describe the bug

`DataProtection.Create(string applicationName, X509Certificate2 certificate)` never works because DataProtection needs an `IXmlRepository` registered, but there is no way to register it with this API.

### Expected Behavior

I expect to be able to use this API, since it is public.

### Steps To Reproduce

```xml
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
  </PropertyGroup>
</Project>
```

comments:
Looks like DataProtection used to try to resolve a default IXmlRepository based on the environment it was in https://github.com/aspnet/DataProtection/blob/5654310a68e276992e1e9f3b0e835816bce1f7f3/src/Microsoft.AspNetCore.DataProtection/DataProtectionServices.cs
